analyses.title_en: Ukraine: Russian robot industry and oil depot bombed - Zelensky criticizes the US after over 70 were murdered in two days

analyses.summary_en: Ukraine bombed a manufacturer of solid fuel for Russian cruise robots and an oil depot last night. President Zelensky criticizes the US regime's attempts at economic settlements with the Russian dictatorship after over 70 Ukrainians were murdered by Russia in two...
key_takeaways_sv: Ukraina bombade en tillverkare av fastbränsle till ryska kryssningsrobotar och en oljedepå i natt.
President Zelenskyj kritiserar USA-regimens försök till ekonomiska uppgörelser med den ryska diktaturen efter att över 70 ukrainare mördats av Ryssland på två dygn.
key_takeaways_en: Ukraine bombed a manufacturer of solid fuel for Russian cruise robots and an oil depot last night.
President Zelensky criticizes the US regime's attempts at economic settlements with the Russian dictatorship after more than 70 Ukrainians were murdered by Russia in two days.

analyses.title_sv: Ukraina: Tolv mördade efter bombning mot busshållplats – minst 37 mördade igår – Yandex serverhallar bombade av Ukraina
analyses.title_en: Ukraine: Twelve killed after bombing of bus stop - at least 37 killed yesterday - Yandex server halls bombed by Ukraine
analyses.summary_sv: Ytterligare tolv civila har mördats efter att Ryssland bombade en busshållplats i Kramatorsk och igår mördades minst 32 i terrorbombningarna, varav minst 22 varav fem barn när ett femvåningshus med sovande familjer bombades av en kryssningsrobot i Tjernihiv.
analyses.summary_en: Twelve more civilians have been killed after Russia bombed a bus stop in Kramatorsk and yesterday at least 32 were killed in the terrorist bombings, including at least 22 including five children when a five-story building with sleeping families was bombed by a cruise robot in Chernihiv.
key_takeaways_sv: Ytterligare tolv civila har mördats efter att Ryssland bombade en busshållplats i Kramatorsk och igår mördades minst 32 i terrorbombningarna, varav minst 22 varav fem barn när ett femvåningshus med sovande familjer bombades av en kryssningsrobot i Tjernihiv.
Den ryska Googlemotsvarigheten Yandex serverhallar ska drabbats av driftsavbrott efter bombningar mot en fabrik i Rjazan Oblast.
key_takeaways_en: Twelve more civilians have been killed after Russia bombed a bus stop in Kramatorsk and yesterday at least 32 were killed in the terrorist bombings, including at least 22 including five children when a five-story building with sleeping families was bombed by a cruise robot in Chernihiv.
The Russian equivalent of Google, Yandex server halls are said to be affected by service interruptions after bombings against a factory in Ryazan Oblast.
analyses.verified_credibility: Hög (öppna källor, geolokalisering och daglig operativ bevakning)
